test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

12 ∶ 16 ∶∶ 18 ∶ ? ∶∶ 24 : 64
solution: Logic : **(Square root of 2nd number) × 3 = 1st number** So, • 12 ∶ 16 ​sqrt{16} × 3 = 12 4 × 3 = 12 12 = 12 (LHS = RHS) And, • 24 ∶ 64
